title: The crust is made of a lattice of atomic nuclei and free electrons.
narration: The crust of a neutron star consists of a lattice of atomic nuclei. It is immersed in a sea of free electrons. This forms the outermost layer. Its composition is crucial for understanding neutron star physics.

claims.text: The crust of a neutron star consists of a lattice of atomic nuclei.
It is immersed in a sea of free electrons.
Its composition is crucial for understanding neutron star physics.
